Growing4096/16384/65504 RAF1.1/4.6/5.9ms; small32append final64k RAF4.5ms. Full64k camera/noop/samefloor redraw4.3–4.7ms, sync Canvas.stroke0.1–0.3ms in thisn1 run.
Large49120-event synthetic batch takes140.6ms and dominates its149.2ms timer gap; this artificial cadence is not actual physical input evidence. No current50ms path-render bottleneck established.
Current source replays all65536 commands in the separate noop geometry diagnostic, so the O(P) path-rebuild mechanism is confirmed even though its measured per-frame cost here is small.

designCorrection.initial: Drag path alone would be insufficient

designCorrection.risk: A naive retained path could reuse previous geometry after the new array reaches an old count; proposal risk, not a current shipped-cache defect.
designCorrection.refined: Drag-owned points-array identity + Path2D + successful command count, lazy render append, discard that cache on construction/append/stroke error; preserve full open path and current style/CTM
designCorrection.mutationAssumption: Current canonical lasso writers append or replace array. Arbitrary prefix mutation/truncate-and-regrow ABA in same array not generally supported by this proposal.
designCorrection.status: Not implemented or publicly exercised as a cache.
